summary: Bump the changelog-derived project version from 0.4.5 (tagged at the placement recovery lab fixes) to 0.4.6 and put the BUG-0539 and BUG-0540 fixes and the Phase 3 and placement acceptance note under the new heading. Correct the hosts affected by BUG-0534 to 0.3.0–0.4.4, because the v0.4.5 tag already contains its fix. API impact: none — no operation is introduced, so no x-introduced-version stamp moves.

guide.reason: Working-version stamps on install, updates, publish and pool guide pages move to 0.4.6; Create a VM troubleshooting now names hosts installed 0.3.0–0.4.4 as the ones needing the nex-media repair. Operator workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: The 0.4.6 fixes change behaviour behind existing operations (documented in their own change record); no operation is introduced, so the generated API reference keeps its version stamps.

roadmap.reason: Release metadata only; phase gates unchanged.

state.reason: No durable product setting or resource is introduced.

verification.method: python3 scripts/release-version.py --current --format both returns 0.4.6 0.4.6; python3 -m unittest tests.test_release_version; python3 scripts/generate_api.py --check; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree; python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_repository_privacy.py. git show v0.4.5 contains the BUG-0534 fix in internal/vmhost/bundled_media.go.
